title: Route Exception Checklist
subtitle: Route Exception: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Route Exception Checklist covers route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan. The dispatch exception coordinator records Route Exception criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Route Exception Checklist keeps Route Exception exceptions visible until the dispatch exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Route Exception Checklist at current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point. Document route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan identity before Route Exception begins. Compare route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan findings with stated Route Exception criteria; route unresolved Route Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Route Exception Checklist, confirm requirements for Route Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Route Exception conditions beyond the dispatch exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Route Exception, identify responsible parties, current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point, and the linked route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan source.

fields.label: Event time, location, and service commitment

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Route Exception facts for route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Route Exception inspection checks
items: Exception type and immediate safety state
Vehicle, cargo, driver, road, weather, and customer impact
Last completed and next affected stop

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Use observed Route Exception evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Dispatch Exception Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Route Exception when safe location, driver fitness, vehicle condition, cargo custody, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Route Exception proof and route unresolved route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan scope to dispatch exception coordinator.
